about: Source of rig-local.json (task C-08b). Only joints listed in a 'joints' pair [start, end] move; single numbers are fixed. Angles follow the XNK convention (xnk-source/docs/Gerak.md): knee / elbow 0 = straight; hip flexion from the trunk line; shoulder 0 = arm at the side, 180 = overhead; ankle 0 = foot at 90 deg to the shin, negative = dorsiflexion. 'torso' and 'thigh' are absolute segment angles in the SVG plane (degrees, y down, figure faces right). 'angles' says which numbers come from the source; 'choice' lists what is our drawing choice, as in Gerak.md 'Yang bukan dari studi'. Variants: 'rig' = parent pattern, 'variant' = what changes; parent frames are reused, only equipment and (if 'arms' is given) the static arm pose change.

bicep-curl-cable/dumbbell.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
bicep-curl-cable/dumbbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Pedrosa 2023 elbow 0-135 deg; Attarieh 2025 arm at the side). Dumbbell, straight-bar and EZ-bar curls: same elbow flexion task, Marcolin G et al. (2018) PeerJ 6:e5165.

bicep-curl-cable/hammer.name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
bicep-curl-cable/hammer.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Pedrosa 2023, Attarieh 2025). The neutral grip turns the forearm, which a side view does not show; the dumbbell is drawn along the line of sight.

bicep-curl-cable/barbell.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
bicep-curl-cable/barbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Pedrosa 2023, Attarieh 2025); Marcolin G et al. (2018) PeerJ 6:e5165 (straight and EZ bar). Side view shows the plate.

bicep-curl-cable/band.name: Bicep Curl (Band)
bicep-curl-cable/band.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Pedrosa 2023, Attarieh 2025); band instead of the cable.

triceps-pushdown/rope.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown (Cable)
triceps-pushdown/rope.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Maeo 2023 cable elbow extension 90-0 deg, neutral arm); only the handle changes.

triceps-pushdown/band.name: Triceps Pushdown (Band)
triceps-pushdown/band.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Maeo 2023); band anchored overhead instead of the cable.

calf-raise-machine/dumbbell.name: Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
calf-raise-machine/dumbbell.variant: dumbbell in the hand, on a step
calf-raise-machine/dumbbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Kassiano 2023 ankle -25 to +25 deg; that study used a horizontal leg-press machine, the parent rig stands). Arms hang at the side (drawing choice).

calf-raise-machine/bodyweight.name: Calf Raise (Bodyweight)
calf-raise-machine/bodyweight.variant: bodyweight on a step, hand on a wall
calf-raise-machine/bodyweight.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: Kassiano 2023 ankle -25 to +25 deg). Single-leg version: the side view draws one leg, so it looks the same. Arm reaching to a wall is a drawing choice.

hip-thrust-machine/barbell.variant: barbell on the hips, feet on the floor
hip-thrust-machine/barbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: McCurdy 2021, hip about 73 deg -> 0 deg); barbell hip thrust: Contreras B et al. (2015) J Appl Biomech 31(6):452-458. Floor drawn at the parent's foot plate height.

hip-thrust-machine/dumbbell.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
hip-thrust-machine/dumbbell.variant: dumbbell on the hips, feet on the floor
hip-thrust-machine/dumbbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: McCurdy 2021); Contreras 2015 (barbell hip thrust, same joint path).

hip-thrust-machine/bodyweight.name: Hip Thrust (Bodyweight)

hip-thrust-machine/bodyweight.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: McCurdy 2021); Contreras 2015 (same joint path).

db-rdl/barbell.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
db-rdl/barbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: knee fixed 15 deg, hip about 79 deg -> upright; Hermann 2026). RDL with a barbell: McAllister MJ et al. (2014) J Strength Cond Res 28(6):1573-1580. Side view shows the plate.

db-row/barbell.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
db-row/barbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: trunk about 68 deg forward, knee 20 deg; Di Fonza 2026 review of row EMG including barbell bent-over row). Side view shows the plate.

lateral-raise/band.name: Lateral Raise (Band)
lateral-raise/band.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: shoulder abduction 4 -> 90 deg, drawing choice; Larsen 2025 dumbbell vs cable). Band from under the feet to each hand.

goblet-squat/dumbbell.name: Squat (Dumbbell)
goblet-squat/dumbbell.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: knee 5 -> 100 deg, Larsen 2025, Kubo 2019). Arms hang straight down (drawing choice).
goblet-squat/dumbbell.armsNote: The parent's shoulder angle changes only because the arms follow the trunk lean while holding the weight at the chest (drawing choice, Gerak.md: only the knee range is sourced); knee, hip and ankle stay identical.

goblet-squat/band.armsNote: The parent's shoulder angle changes only because the arms follow the trunk lean while holding the weight at the chest (drawing choice, Gerak.md: only the knee range is sourced); knee, hip and ankle stay identical.

goblet-squat/bodyweight.name: Squat (Bodyweight)
goblet-squat/bodyweight.source: Parent angles (Gerak.md: knee 5 -> 100 deg, Larsen 2025, Kubo 2019). Arms held forward (drawing choice).
goblet-squat/bodyweight.armsNote: The parent's shoulder angle changes only because the arms follow the trunk lean while holding the weight at the chest (drawing choice, Gerak.md: only the knee range is sourced); knee, hip and ankle stay identical.
